title: AI Assurance and Red-Teaming Delivery for Advisory Firms
summary: A white-label technical partner for advisory firms: we run adversarial tests on clients' chatbots, voice agents and copilots and deliver framework-mapped evidence for your report.

seo.title: White-Label AI Red-Teaming for Advisory Firms | VipraTech
seo.description: White-label technical delivery for AI assurance: adversarial testing of client chatbots, voice agents and copilots with evidence mapped to AI frameworks.

designed_for: Director, Technology Risk and IT Audit

problem.intro: Banks, insurers and product companies are asking their auditors and consultants for assurance over the AI systems they have shipped: chatbots, voice agents, internal copilots and agents that call tools. Advisory firms have the governance frameworks and the client relationships, but adversarial testing of an LLM application is specialised engineering work that few risk teams have staffed for.

pain_points.title: Demand outpaces skills
pain_points.detail: Governance reviewers can assess policies and controls but are not equipped to run prompt injection or multi-turn jailbreak campaigns.

pain_points.title: Checklists do not test behaviour
pain_points.detail: A policy review shows that a control exists, not that the bot actually resists a determined user over a long conversation.

pain_points.title: Evidence must map to frameworks
pain_points.detail: Clients expect findings tied to OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications, NIST AI RMF, ISO/IEC 42001, the EU AI Act or RBI's FREE-AI framework.

pain_points.title: Hiring for uncertain demand is risky
pain_points.detail: Building an in-house red team before the pipeline is steady leaves expensive specialists under-used.

solution.overview: We work as the technical delivery team behind your AI assurance engagements, under your brand and engagement terms. Your team scopes the work with the client and owns the conclusion; we run the testing. For each system in scope, whether a support chatbot, a Hindi or Hinglish voice agent, a RAG copilot or an agent with tool access, we build adversarial test plans covering prompt injection, jailbreaks, data leakage, unauthorised tool use, harmful advice and sector-specific conduct failures. Tests run as repeatable multi-turn playbooks, and each result is recorded as PASS, RISK or FAIL with transcripts, mapped to the frameworks your report uses, and handed over as a working-paper-ready evidence pack.
capabilities: Test planning aligned to your engagement scope and the client's AI risk register
Multi-turn adversarial playbooks for chatbots, voice agents, RAG copilots and tool-using agents
Sector conduct tests such as mis-selling, collection conduct or unauthorised investment advice
PASS, RISK and FAIL results with full transcripts or call audio, reproducible on retest
Mapping to OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications, MITRE ATLAS, NIST AI RMF, ISO/IEC 42001 and EU AI Act duties
Evidence packs and draft technical findings in your report template, plus retests after remediation

workflow.title: Scope with the advisory team
workflow.detail: We agree systems, access, test windows and rules of engagement with your engagement manager and the client.

workflow.title: Build the test plan
workflow.detail: Adversarial playbooks are selected and adapted to the client's sector, languages and risk register.

workflow.title: Run the tests
workflow.detail: Playbooks run against the client's system in the agreed environment, with every turn recorded.

workflow.title: Classify and verify results
workflow.detail: Each result is scored PASS, RISK or FAIL, and borderline results are reviewed jointly with your manager.

workflow.title: Map evidence
workflow.detail: Verified results are mapped to the frameworks in your report and assembled into an evidence pack.

workflow.title: Report and retest
workflow.detail: Your firm issues the report, and we retest fixed issues after the client's remediation.

inputs: Engagement scope and rules of engagement
Access to the system under test in a test or staging environment
System prompts, policies and tool definitions where the client shares them
Client AI risk register and applicable regulations
Your firm's report template and framework mapping
outputs: PASS, RISK and FAIL results log with transcripts and audio
Draft technical findings with remediation suggestions
human_in_the_loop: A VipraTech engineer verifies every RISK and FAIL result before it enters the evidence pack, and borderline results are reviewed jointly with your engagement manager. Your partners decide severity in the final report and issue the conclusion; we provide the technical evidence.
integrations: Client chatbot APIs or web widgets
Telephony or SIP endpoints for voice agents
LLM platforms such as Azure OpenAI, AWS Bedrock or Google Vertex AI
Your working paper or GRC tool
Jira or similar for remediation tracking
guardrails: Written rules of engagement and test windows approved by the client
Synthetic test data only, never real customer personal data
Tool-using agents tested with sandboxed or non-destructive actions
White-label confidentiality under your NDA and engagement terms
Evidence stored in your environment or transferred encrypted to named contacts
compliance_notes: Evidence is mapped to frameworks such as NIST AI RMF, ISO/IEC 42001 and the OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications to help your team evidence its conclusions; it is not a certification.
For Indian financial-sector clients, tests can reflect RBI's FREE-AI framework (2025) recommendations and DPDP Act 2023 obligations; EU AI Act duties are considered where the client serves the EU.

pilot.scope: One client system, such as a customer-facing chatbot or voice agent, on a joint engagement with a fixed playbook set and one retest.
deliverables: Joint delivery model and rules-of-engagement template
Test plan and coverage matrix for the pilot system
Verified results log and evidence pack in your template

what_we_measure.how: Scenarios executed per agreed risk category, recorded in the coverage matrix.
RISK and FAIL results confirmed after engineer and joint review.
Findings shown as fixed when the same playbooks are re-run after remediation.
Time your team spends adapting our evidence into the final report.

faqs.q: Do you work under our brand?
faqs.a: Yes. We deliver as your technical team under your engagement terms and NDA, and reports go out under your name. We join client calls only if you want us there, and we do not contact your clients directly.

faqs.q: What kinds of AI systems can you test?
faqs.a: Text chatbots, Hindi, Hinglish and English voice agents reached by phone or SIP, RAG copilots over internal documents, and agents that call tools or APIs. We agree the systems and access method during scoping.

faqs.q: Do you certify the client's AI system?
faqs.a: No. We provide technical test evidence mapped to the frameworks you choose. Your firm forms the assurance conclusion, and neither of us presents the work as a certification.
Usually as a fixed fee per system tested, based on scope and the number of playbooks, with retests priced separately. A first joint engagement can run as a pilot to agree the working model.
